programme.desc: The Concours d'Elegance from Amelia Island: Featuring bomb-proof Conquest Knight XV, '69 Camaro Hagerty Fixer-Upper, and car-enthusiast John Oates.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.desc: Dale Tallman started fighting at the tender age of 5 years old. He fell in love with boxing through participating in his family tradition of watching Muhammad Ali. He is now a full-time Health Director and he sees it as a part of his calling to help other people live healthy lives. He works full time, but always finds the time in his schedule to run during lunch breaks and train after work. Tallman is always striving to improve his conditioning and technique. It is inspiring to watch how as an independent fighter Dale maintains his own routine and continues to mentor other people around him to live their best lives.

programme.title: FishON! | Northern Adventures: Mid-Summer Walleye Quest with Cameron Racine from Mercury Canada
programme.desc: Join us on an exhilarating journey deep into the heart of Northern Ontario as we tackle mid-summer walleye fishing like never before! Guided by the rising sun, we gear up with our Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake for a day filled with fishing action and good times. Joining the adventure is Mercury Canada Marketing Manager Cameron Racine, adding expertise and excitement to this unforgettable outing. Don't miss the fun, the fish, and the breathtaking scenery!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Cedros Island Goes Off, Part Two
programme.desc: We're returning to one of our all-time favorite destinations in Baja, Mexico - Cedros Island, with Jose and Cedros Outdoor Adventures. People often ask us, 'Why do you return to Cedros Island?' The answer is straightforward: the fishing is absolutely ridiculous almost every single time. Our Stoked on Fishing charter makes a point of showing up in the middle of October for a reason. That reason? It's all about the variety of species available to catch, starting with yellowfin tuna, dorado, halibut, and the elusive Mr. Yellowtail. It's game time - let's go fishing in Baja!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank: Part Two
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: His Name was King
programme.desc: A relentless bounty hunter pursues a brutal gang of gunrunners deep into Mexico. As he crosses the lawless borderlands, he’s drawn into a deadly chase where justice and vengeance blur in the desert heat.

programme.title: Apache Gold
programme.desc: The construction of the Great Western Railroad causes tension between settlers and Native American tribes. Criminal gang leader Santer seeks control of a gold mine on sacred Apache land and manipulates the railroad route through it. Old Shatterhand, working as a surveyor, uncovers the scheme and tries to warn the Apaches to prevent war.

programme.title: Reverend's Colt
programme.desc: Reverend Miller arrives in Tucson where he wants to build a church, but on the very day of his arrival a gang raids the bank and the people of Tucson, suspicious of the new reverend because he is carrying a gun, immediately blame him for the robbery.

programme.title: Shango
programme.desc: Shango is a Texas Ranger who finds himself up against a former Confederate officer and his gang of thugs who have been terrorizing a local border town in search of gold.

programme.title: Dead are Countless
programme.desc: As a child, Johnny witnessed his father’s death at the hands of soldiers. Now an outlaw, he seeks revenge by killing soldiers whenever possible. Lieutenant Garringo is tasked with capturing Johnny and bringing him back alive. A dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with Garringo determined to fulfill his mission.

programme.title: Two Brothers in Trinity
programme.desc: After inheriting a land plot in a dusty place called Trinity, the antagonistic half-brothers, Lester and Jesse, reunite to pursue different aspirations, only to find themselves neck-deep in trouble. Will they ever fulfil their dreams?

programme.title: Buddy Goes West
programme.desc: Two outlaws, "The Doctor" and the Indian Girolamo, help a village fight a gang and a corrupt sheriff who has discovered gold beneath the town.

programme.title: Wanted
programme.desc: A local sheriff is unjustly accused of murder in a small town and forced to flee.

programme.title: Watch Out Gringo! Sabata Will Return
programme.desc: After a daring gold robbery, bandit Carrancho double-crosses his gang and hides the loot in a grave. As ruthless outlaws and gunmen close in, the chase for the stolen treasure turns into a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
programme.desc: A Civil War veteran swears revenge when he returns home to find his family killed by a local gang.

programme.title: Viva! Django
programme.desc: Django is on the trail of some renegade outlaws who raped and killed his wife. En route, he rescues a horse thief from an impromptu hanging. He discovers the man knows who committed the murder. The men team up and head west for revenge.

programme.title: Rattler Kid
programme.desc: Falsely convicted for robbing an army treasury, Tony Garrett escapes prison and sets out to find the real criminals responsible. As he hunts for revenge, he faces dangers and uncovers dark truths, determined to clear his name and make the true culprits pay for their actions.

programme.title: Night of the Serpent
programme.desc: In a corrupt Mexican village, Commander Hernandez and his men plot to steal young Manuel’s inheritance. When the broken ex-gunslinger Luke is drawn into their scheme by the revolutionary Pancho, betrayal and vengeance ignite in a tale of greed and redemption.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a farmhand, accidentally impersonates the notorious outlaw "Bloody" Ben Harris. Now, on a treasure hunt, he must rely on a group of wild misfits to outsmart the outlaw he's pretending to be. With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.

programme.title: A Pistol for Django
programme.desc: When Django’s fiancée is kidnapped by the ruthless Cortez brothers after a bank robbery, he joins forces with an American ally and agent Fulton, who’s tasked with recovering the stolen gold. Together, they face the gang hiding in a remote cave for a perilous rescue and revenge mission.

programme.title: For a Book of Dollars
programme.desc: A bounty hunter named Amen is hired by a group of nuns to recover stolen money. However, the nuns turn out to be female desperadoes in disguise, plotting to retrieve the booty pillaged by the ruthless outlaw Catapult and his gang. Amen must navigate a world of deception, danger, and betrayal to complete the job.

programme.title: Payment in Blood
programme.desc: In 1867 Texas, after the Civil War, Colonel Thomas Blake and his men refuse to surrender, raiding Yankee towns. Rumors swirl that Blake kills for pleasure, not the Confederacy, leading to large bounties for his capture. However, Blake seeks $200,000 that vanished during the war from Confederate coffers. He sends Chamaco Gonzales to track down the missing fortune, hidden in General Beauregard's strong box.

programme.title: The Desperado Trail
programme.desc: After the Civil War, renegade Rollins and his gang stir conflict between settlers and Native Americans. Apache chief Winnetou and his friend Old Shatterhand try to preserve peace, but Winnetou is framed for the murder of Chief White Buffalo’s son using his own knife. Old Shatterhand must uncover the truth and clear his friend’s name.

programme.title: Death Knows No Time
programme.desc: A poor Mexican farmer, evicted from his land, turns to banditry and ends up in prison. While he serves his sentence, his young son is adopted by a wealthy family. Once freed, he sets out to reclaim both his child and the $200,000 he hid after a bank robbery, facing a struggle between love and greed.

programme.title: They Called Him Trinity
programme.desc: An ex-sheriff sets out to find the bandits who beat and murdered his sister.

programme.title: A Few Dollars for Django
programme.desc: Regan, a bounty hunter looking to start a new life, is pulled back into action when a murder sends him after bank robbers. In Montana, he steps into a range war between farmers and cattlemen while investigating. With a sheriff's star in hand, Regan must navigate dangerous territory to bring justice while seeking his own peace.

programme.title: And God Said to Cain
programme.desc: After ten years in prison for a crime he didn’t commit, ex-Confederate officer Gary Hamilton returns to seek revenge on Acombar, the man who framed him and stole both his gold and his lover. Surrounded by enemies, Hamilton uses the town’s secret tunnels to strike back in a stormy, haunting showdown.

programme.title: Trusting Is Good... Shooting Is Better
programme.desc: Three bandits steal $200,000, but betrayal leaves the loot buried with a dying man. Glenn Hilton pursues the money, while the surviving thieves, a scheming banker, and the alluring Liz all try to claim a share. Greed, deceit, and double-crosses spark a chaotic hunt for the cash.

programme.title: A Few Bullets More
programme.desc: Billy starts as an innocent outlaw protecting his mother but soon becomes a ruthless killer. When love gives him hope for change, Pat Garrett, a fatherly friend, helps him try to turn his life around. Yet fate drags Billy back into violence, and Garrett is ultimately credited with his death.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Michael "California" Random, is released from prison and goes to Missouri with his partner William.

programme.title: Paid in Blood
programme.desc: Jeff Cameron is Tom Carter and he’s a man on a mission to get revenge for his brother Jerry, who was gunned down after pulling his life savings out of the Rio Canyon town bank.

programme.title: The Cold Killer
programme.desc: José Desman kills his employer, former judge Salazar, who had sentenced his father. This story explores revenge and personal justice as the son confronts the man responsible for his family’s tragedy.

programme.title: $1,000 on the Black
programme.desc: Twelve years ago, Sartana framed his brother Johnny for murder and stole his girlfriend. Now the town's undisputed boss and doted over by his possessive mother, Sartana seems safe - until, his sentence served, Johnny rides back into town.

programme.title: A Sky Full of Stars for a Roof

Elisabetta, her neighbour, on the other hand, is a successful doctor, too closed in her schemes to realise her husband is homosexual until she is left alone with many questions. When Gianmarco, a family man in a work crisis, saves Germana's daughter from an accident, sparks fly between them. Too bad she does not know that he is married and is Elisabetta's friend. Fate brings them face to face with reality when, during a holiday in Sicily, they all meet again, forcing them to confront each other.

Seyi starts a new relationship but a chance meeting with Mabel has him questioning his new life.

programme.title: Love Is A Trickster
programme.desc: A tomboy explores feminine ways to win back her man, but an unexpected guest poses a new interest.

programme.title: Love Lost and Found
programme.desc: When Mr Dan sees sparks fly between hard-working Chinwe and his seemingly useless son Dave, he decides to dig deeper to find out why there is hostility between them and uses the opportunity to teach his son a lesson.

programme.title: Mr Nice Guy
programme.desc: Fiona is shocked by her friend, Isabel’s cold reaction to her long-distance boyfriend Tyler coming back to town. Meanwhile, Isabel thinks Fiona’s obsession with her relationship is starting to cross the line.

programme.title: Vacation Gone Wrong
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A young man goes on a vacation in the village and parties with the young women there. When he impregnates a village girl, he thinks he can go scot-free, but he soon finds out that Amaka is not just any girl and her connections to the law in the village makes it impossible for him to escape.

programme.title: Bounded By Love
programme.desc: Heartbroken after a painful rejection, Tega drowns his sorrow in a nightclub where he meets a mysterious escort. What begins as a one-night escape turns into something deeper and unexpected.

programme.title: Atarodo
programme.desc: Coming from a place of anger management issues, Ugo retraces his steps and seeks a fresh start in his relationship with Dupe who also has plenty of dirty little secrets in her past.

programme.title: All I Ask
programme.desc: Mrs Eugene goes from thinking she is in a happy marriage to finding out her husband is having an affair, while battling life-threatning illness. Will she put her family back together on time?

programme.title: Love Gone Mad
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Tomike is a kind and loving woman who tries to please everyone. She has been with her boyfriend, Ayomide, for several years with promises of marriage that doesn’t happen. Ayomide takes advantage of Tomike’s kindness, including manipulating her into abortions, claiming he is not ready to be a father; however Tomike finally snaps when she finds out he is the father to another woman’s child.

programme.title: The Love I Prayed For
programme.desc: When kind-hearted Ella gets a new job as the housekeeper to a man with an unfaithful girlfriend, she takes it upon herself to help him with his broken heart but where will that leave her own relationship?

programme.title: All Shades Of Amanda
programme.desc: Love finds a young girl who dwells in the captivity of her past heartbreak but she tries to fight it.

programme.title: Bruises and Bliss Ep25
programme.desc: The family that live together must stay together that is Uchechi's idea of having everyone under one roof where she rules but little does she know that love and respect is earned not forced.

programme.title: Bruises and Bliss Ep26
programme.desc: The family that live together must stay together that is Uchechi's idea of having everyone under one roof where she rules but little does she know that love and respect is earned not forced.

programme.title: A Little Like Happiness
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Jude, a bus driver, and Monica, a lawyer, meet when Jude cusses Monica over change from a fare. Their meeting turns into an unlikely friendship as Monica begins to advise Jude on improving his life.

programme.title: Billionaire Husband or Nothing
programme.desc: Evelyn must do all she can to find out why she sabotages her happiness just when she is about to get her "happily ever after".

programme.title: Unraveled
programme.desc: A family is in disarray after the head of the home dies in a car accident. His wife and daughter become cruel to those around them without any regard for the consequences.

programme.title: Greed
programme.desc: A young man's plan for marriage is thwarted due to him being unemployed and not having a home of his own. Whilst this is going on he is pressured by his family to take more responsibility for his life.

programme.title: Mine Before Yours

programme.title: Little Lies
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Ruth, a young widow, finds out about her husband’s other wife when she visits the morgue to claim his body. She is confused about this situation and confronts the mystery woman, where she finds out that her husband has two names and two different identities. The mystery continues when she discovers his phone keeps getting messages in different languages. She resolves to taking the matter to the DSS but is dismissed, causing her to go to the press but she is suddenly threatened by unknown gunmen and asked to run away forever.

programme.title: One Crazy Day
programme.desc: An airport luggage mix-up causes a chance meeting between Pamela and Lawrence, which leads to connections and consequences that changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Twisted Emotion
programme.desc: Newly married Angel, starts to believe her life is boring and her marriage unsatisfying when her ex-boyfriend, and first love, comes back into the picture. She decides to reconnect with him for old times sake but long-buried feelings begin to resurface.

programme.title: Lurikos
programme.desc: Terminally-ill Michael believes he has found new love with Serena after his wife is killed in a car accident. However, things are complicated when he finds out Serena is promised to another, but will true love find a way through all these challenges?

programme.title: Digging Deep
programme.desc: A group of young women facing very different challenges in their relationships, from infidelity to negligence, try to help each other out with their problems but things do not go as planned.

programme.title: In The Pursuit of Love
programme.desc: In his quest to find true love, a young CEO decides to disguise himself and hide his true identity. He meets a female who challenges his whole idea of love and hustle. Will this be his final bus stop?

programme.title: Anger Of Death
programme.desc: A priest, known for his outspokenness, is faced with the challenge of standing up for his people through his prominent position.

programme.title: His Mystery Lover
programme.desc: Bryan's indecision between two women costs him true love, leaving him unable to commit and ultimately missing out on a genuine connection.

programme.title: Kill Fred

programme.title: Officer Arjun Singh IPS

programme.title: Maine Dil Tujhko Diya
programme.desc: College stud and a famed band player Ajay is introduced to the stunning daughter of a business tycoon named Ayesha. Ajay is smitten by Ayesha's modesty and coyness and what starts off as a mere acquaintance soon turns into full-blown love affair. But Ayesha's father Mr. Verma is unhappy with their union and his associate Mr. Chopra takes advantage of his discontentment. Mr. Chopra, wanting to take over Mr. Verma's fortune, suggests his own son for Ayesha and brainwashes him about Ajay. The situation takes a deadly turn when a hit-man is appointed to end Ajay's life. But seeing Ajay's aggressive stubbornness to be with Ayesha, Mr. Verma gives him a challenge, to find his lady-love within a day or leave from her life forever. Ajay accepts the challenge, unaware that a bigger conspiracy is at work to tear them apart once and for all.

In this video, I show you three different ways to treat the wood surface so that even WITH a water-based topcoat, the wood looks more like an oil-based finish.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: In the 1950s, companies like Tatra from Czechoslovakia introduced advanced, even pioneering automobiles. The clientele was exclusive, which is why now these streamlined cars are big rarities. We tracked down the owner of a 1937 Tatra T87.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 Targa with its lightweight construction is an iconic car. Also: the Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS is more pf a race than a road car. And: the 1930 Bentley Blower and the dainty British roadster, the Sunbeam Tiger.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The 1967 Ford Fairlane GTA in NASCAR trim. Also: the 1995 Chrysler 300 C was the most powerful production vehicle in the US. And: the 1949 Cadillac Series 62 convertible set new standards in terms of luxury.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The 1947 Triumph 1800 Roadster provides space for 5 fresh air fans. Also: Le Jog, the toughest classic car rally in Europe. A German women's team takes on the challenge in their VW Iltis. And: a charming oldie, the 1919 Wolseley Stellite.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: At the "Day of Thunder" in Magdeburg, Germany, two- and four-wheelers take part in Europe's most famous 1/8 mile race.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Already in the eighth season of the German Race Wars, visitors from over 20 countries make their pilgrimage to the big event. And: The Mini John Cooper Works is the racing version of the Bavarian racer. Arden turns it into the Arden Mini AM 3.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: For BMW tuner Manhart Racing, the Nurburgring Nordschleife is the ideal place to celebrate its 25th anniversary. As part of the Track Days, customers and interested parties will have the opportunity to get to know the Manhart models.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Once a year, car tuning fans from all over the country meet at Neue Messe Dresden for the XS CarNight. On 35,000 square metres automotive dreams can be admired there while the lights go out outside.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Unlike the countless Show & Shine car meetings, at the Rust'n'Roll the older means the better. Only when the vehicles look really old and are as rusty as possible are they considered beautiful.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The NitrolympX is a motor sport event that was first held in Hockenheim in 1986. With about 30,000 spectators and around 300 participants, it is the largest international drag race event in Europe.

programme.title: A tuned Beetle!
programme.desc: It looks like a Volkswagen Beetle from the Seventies. But with contemporary tuning, 90 horse power and 112 mph top speed, it promises unlimited driving pleasure.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We took the Ferrari 458 Italia for a spring ride around Lake Starnberg. Also: a test drive of BMW's 6 series convertible at the Table Mountain in South Africa. And: the Chevrolet Orlando family van.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Audi built only 333 units of its GT model. We tested the everyday use compatibility of the R8 GT. In addition: the Mazda MX5, the most popular roadster in the world. And: the Mercedes-AMG GT3.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: More efficiency, less weight and more sportiness is what Audi promotes in order to win the race against BMW and Mercedes with their A6 2.0 TDI. Also: Patrick Dempsey and his racing team at the Grand Am Rolex Sportscar GT series.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We put the Wiesmann MF5 at the racetrack in Spa-Francochamps in the Belgian Ardennes to the test. Also: Audi A1 vs. Mini Cooper RS. And: the GT Academy 2011 qualifying rounds.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Nurburgring 24 Hours is considered the most difficult long distance race in motor sports. Volkswagen set themselves this challenge with a car built especially for this occasion, their Golf 24.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Mercedes-Benz SL 65 AMG is the ultimate German muscle car in a tailor-made suit. Also: the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG, the Formula 1 safety car. And: BMW's 6 series models.

programme.title: Jaguar D-Type
programme.desc: The high-achiever at the 24 hours of Le Mans. The Jaguar D-Type won the toughest endurance race in the world three times in a row.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The emphatically sporty cars and motorbikes of BMW are equally successful with customers and in racing. However, the former aircraft engine manufacturer's entry into automobile production threatened to fail at an early stage.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Porsche 550 Spyder is small and fast, but only 140 units were built. It was Porsche's first racing sports car and laid the foundation for the German manufacturer to be considered a force in car racing today.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Racing has been a matter of the heart for Ford for over 100 years. Henry Ford already wins the first race with his first car. Thousands of other victories were to follow.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The development of engineering at BMW has always been closely linked to motorsport. Racing has always played a decisive role in shaping the brand and setting the pace for its future.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In the 1980s and 90s, Porsche races from victory to victory. A McLaren with Porsche engine wins the Formula 1 World Championship three times. In Le Mans in 1982, Porsche starts an unbelievable winning streak with the new 956/962 prototype.

programme.title: Glas 1700 GT
programme.desc: The Glas GT looks like a Ferrari, but comes from the province of Lower Bavaria in Germany. In the early 1960s it was one of the few German sports cars.

programme.title: Peugeot 205 Turbo 16
programme.desc: Peugeot released this classic, all wheel drive monster for one purpose only: It should bring the World Rally Championship to France. The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 shook up the rally world in the 80s.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What a joy it is when elegance meets extraordinary performance! The Maserati Quattroporte, the Kelleners BMW GranCoupe and Porsche's 911 4S embody the perfect melange. We took a closer look at these prime examples of power combined with style.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Two weeks before the start of the famous 24 hours of Le Mans race, all teams are busy testing their cars on the traditional long distance track in France. Bad weather, accidents and a lot of tension, we documented the official test days in Le Mans 2013.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 shows stylistic modesty like no other sports car in the world. It doesn't boast, avoids any loud appearance and puts form over function. We explored the history behind this iconic sports car and the reason why it has been so successful for more than 50 years. In addition: Porsche's Turbo S model, the traditional top model of the brand's 911 production series.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 - The first turbocharged Aston Martin
programme.desc: Aston Martin are pursuing future success with their DB11 model. Apart from the beautiful new design, turbochargers are used for the first time, but, not to worry, the magnificent V12 remains in place.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This episode features Action Concept's stunt highlights from all previous specials, from exciting car stunts to meticulously choreographed fight scenes and even some snowmobile shootout action.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This time, an industrial site is the scene for the stunt extravaganza. The Stunt Heroes' objective: jump through a truck trailer with a car. As usual with such risky car stunts, careful planning, preparation, timing and precision are of the essence.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: In a race between a dump truck and a car, man and machine are brought to their limits. Stuntman Stefan receives a load of gravel for his birthday, instead of confetti.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: The Audi S8 Plus is by no means underpowered, but it is and remains faithful to this model series' understatement. Those who want more power can get a boost from MTM.

programme.title: Ferrari California T
programme.desc: The Ferrari California T has a lot of Italian passion and elegant lines to offer. Super sports car cabriolets are popular all over the world. It is no wonder that more and more manufacturers are 'opening up'.

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: With the Active Hybrid 7, unlike with its predecessor bearing the same model name, BMW now banks on a full hybrid, which can also be driven solely with electric power.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a rather unique type of car race in the mountains of Colorado, USA. It's exciting, tough and dangerous, and in 1987, two-time world rally champion Walter Röhrl took his Audi Sport Quattro S1 to the top.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In the 1930s the famous Silver Arrows by Auto Union that were designed by Ferdinand Porsche celebrated great successes at the European Drivers' Championship and several Grand Prix races despite the strong competition by Mercedes-Benz.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The International Championship for Manufacturers was a rally series which was run from 1970 to 1972. Car manufacturers such as Porsche, Renault, Opel and Ford took part in this competition, with Ford having an exceptionally successful year in 1972.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Lightweight
programme.desc: An iconic racing car and one of only 29 ever built! We accompanied the Mercedes 300 SL 'lightweight' on its premiere drive at the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB
programme.desc: The long version of the Bentley Mulsanne is a prime example of a chauffeured limousine. With it, the British luxury car brand has set the bar extremely high when it comes to automotive comfort.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Since the 1950s, the Mercedes-Benz SL has been regarded as the sports car legend par excellence. Beginning with the legendary 300 SL with its gullwing doors, the SL series stands for innovation and cultivated sportiness.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Ford Mustang is the icon of all sports coupes and convertibles - no other car conveys so much the lifestyle of the 1960s. With its striking shape and powerful engines the Mustang drove itself into the hearts of millions.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland or the British royals, they all drove the Austin Mini. Designed on a napkin, the Mini starts an incredible career in 1959: the revolutionary Mini is considered the prototype of all small cars.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: A car that everyone knows and that almost everyone has ridden in, a car that has conquered all continents and bears an unmistakable nickname, the Volkswagen Beetle.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Ferrari - the name alone raises the pulse. No other sports car has as much magic and myth as the fiery red icons from Maranello. Whether on the road or on the race track, these cars are the centre of attention.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Beradino
programme.desc: A „bella macchina“, a beautiful car - but not designed by masters like Bertone or Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen from Neuss in Germany built the Beradino by hand.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Normal is not enough. Tuning is a way of life for many car fans - the search for ever more horsepower, better sound and extraordinary design.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Monza Rally Show is a classic among drift shows. Plus: a Mercedes G-Class becomes a special off-roader 'ORC Bull'. And: a Mini Countryman becomes a Dakar Rally competitor.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Porsche is like a religion! The faiths: Punk, technology and racing. Porsche punk Magnus Walker preaches individualism for historic vehicles. Technology has been embodied by Alois RUF since 1983. And for the racers, there is the GT3 RS.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: BMW tries to combine the electric future with fuel-saving features in the i8. In addition: the 'Race Chip' is tested on a 3,000-kilometre route. And: What is the benefit of the switchable performance enhancement from DTE Systems?

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: They are the US car icons par excellence: Chevy, Ford Mustang and Corvette. At Race 61, fans of historic racers pay homage to their heroes. And: we explore the history of the Ford Mustang up to the current model.

programme.title: Harley-Davidson Trio
programme.desc: We took a look at three very different Harley-Davidson models. The versatile Switchback Dyna, the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, and the bad-boy motorcycle Softail Slim.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Ken Block - Gymkhana Grid
programme.desc: Spectacular drifts are to be expected when Ken Block visits the Gymkhana Grid.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new BMW One M Coupe from former race car driver Ralf Kelleners: the KS1 RS. Also: Toyota present their TS 030 hybrid at the 24-hours race of Le Mans. And: Subaru's XV crossover stands out from the company's model range.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The 'little' Mercedes-Benz S250 with a four-cylinder engine needs so little fuel that one could call this car a piggybank. Also: the power packages Nissan 370 Z and Wiesmann GT MF5. And: the ADAC Eco Test.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new Porsche Boxter, a real open-top sports car. Also: Volkswagen presents the new Passat Alltrack, a real allrounder. And: Fiat's successful Panda model in its third generation version.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter belongs to the class of commercial vehicles. The light transporter is the dream for every tradesman. The third generation Sprinter is sleeker, more modern and more variable than ever.

programme.title: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a rather unique type of car race in the mountains of Colorado, USA. It's exciting, tough and dangerous, and in 1987, two-time world rally champion Walter Röhrl took his Audi Sport Quattro S1 to the top.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In the 1930s the famous Silver Arrows by Auto Union that were designed by Ferdinand Porsche celebrated great successes at the European Drivers' Championship and several Grand Prix races despite the strong competition by Mercedes-Benz.

programme.title: Classic Races

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Lightweight
programme.desc: An iconic racing car and one of only 29 ever built! We accompanied the Mercedes 300 SL 'lightweight' on its premiere drive at the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB
programme.desc: The long version of the Bentley Mulsanne is a prime example of a chauffeured limousine. With it, the British luxury car brand has set the bar extremely high when it comes to automotive comfort.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What a joy it is when elegance meets extraordinary performance! The Maserati Quattroporte, the Kelleners BMW GranCoupe and Porsche's 911 4S embody the perfect melange. We took a closer look at these prime examples of power combined with style.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Two weeks before the start of the famous 24 hours of Le Mans race, all teams are busy testing their cars on the traditional long distance track in France. Bad weather, accidents and a lot of tension, we documented the official test days in Le Mans 2013.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 shows stylistic modesty like no other sports car in the world. It doesn't boast, avoids any loud appearance and puts form over function. We explored the history behind this iconic sports car and the reason why it has been so successful for more than 50 years. In addition: Porsche's Turbo S model, the traditional top model of the brand's 911 production series.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 - The first turbocharged Aston Martin
programme.desc: Aston Martin are pursuing future success with their DB11 model. Apart from the beautiful new design, turbochargers are used for the first time, but, not to worry, the magnificent V12 remains in place.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Aston Martin Rapide S
programme.desc: Aston Martin is breaking new ground with the sport sedan – the „Rapide S“. Ever since the official car of James Bond became the Aston Martin, this brand has achieved cult status. Desirable, timelessly elegant, 2-door sports coupes are the DNA. But even the venerable British brand does not escape evolution - because with the Rapide S, Aston Martin goes new ways.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We test drove the Rallye Defender and examined how a Jeep Wrangler with only few modifications can double in price. Also: how does the Fiat Panda 4x4 fare in Iceland? Also: Land Rover's Bowler Defender and Volvo's 6-wheeler, the Laplander.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We spent a day in snowy Austria with rally professional Niki Schelle in a Suzuki SX4 S-Cross. Also: why is the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution perfect for drifting? And: Mercedes and Chrysler present their all-wheel concept cars.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We show how to have a lot of fun on gravel roads in a Subaru WRX STI. Also: in the 1990s, Ford had a successful go at rally competitions with the Ford Escort RS Cosworth. And: the Volkswagen Polo WRC shows its 4x4 skills.

programme.title: Arabella Classics
programme.desc: Rare Automobiles and stunning views! The Arabella Classics, one of the most exclusive Classic Car Rallies in Europe.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This episode features Action Concept's stunt highlights from all previous specials, from exciting car stunts to meticulously choreographed fight scenes and even some snowmobile shootout action.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This time, an industrial site is the scene for the stunt extravaganza. The Stunt Heroes' objective: jump through a truck trailer with a car. As usual with such risky car stunts, careful planning, preparation, timing and precision are of the essence.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: In a race between a dump truck and a car, man and machine are brought to their limits. Stuntman Stefan receives a load of gravel for his birthday, instead of confetti.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: The Audi S8 Plus is by no means underpowered, but it is and remains faithful to this model series' understatement. Those who want more power can get a boost from MTM.

programme.title: Ferrari California T

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: With the Active Hybrid 7, unlike with its predecessor bearing the same model name, BMW now banks on a full hybrid, which can also be driven solely with electric power.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Die-hard Porsche fan Marco Wendlandt makes his dream come true: driving a 1984 Porsche 911 coupe. With the help from Big Mike, a car dealer from Los Angeles, he tracks down the car in San Francisco.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: With his newly bought Porsche 911 coupe, Marco heads to L.A. to meet one of the best known Porsche enthusiasts of the world: Magnus Walker, who invites Marco to visit his workshop and his collection.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: On his way to Las Vegas Marco drops by Big Mike in the Apple Valley. Together they meet Big Mike's friends from the Kustos family, who once used to be trendsetters in the Californian car customizing scene.

programme.title: BMW 503
programme.desc: The noble four-seater 503 convertible was one of BMWs most exclusive models in the 1950s. Many international sports and movie stars and other wealthy customers were fond of this sporty luxury vehicle.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Once again it was time for the VLN Endurance Racing Championship. While the drivers were doing their test laps, we had a look behind the scenes and explored what went on in the pit lanes.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The fourth race of the VLN season is usually regarded as a dress rehearsal for the 24-hour race. For the top teams and best drivers it is the last opportunity for a really thorough test.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: We present the highlights of last week. The 24 hour race was exciting, as usual. In addition, we explored the 'Strong Man Run' and took a look at the tourist drivers

programme.title: BMW 503
programme.desc: The noble four-seater 503 convertible was one of BMWs most exclusive models in the 1950s. Many international sports and movie stars and other wealthy customers were fond of this sporty luxury vehicle.

programme.title: Volvo S90
programme.desc: It looks sportier than one might expect from the Swedes. The taillights frame the powerful looking rear. On the inside, the Volvo S90 impresses with the finest materials and soft nappa leather.

programme.title: Alfa Romeo 6C 2500SS
programme.desc: Founded in 1910, the iconic Italian car manufacturer Alfa Romeo experienced a very eventful history. Their 6C 2500 SS model is right in the middle of the company's more than 100-year history. It combined new technology with an early post-war appearance.

programme.title: Small City Cars
programme.desc: Small city cars reflect the change of times in regards to new technology and eco-awareness. In 2023, Mitsubishi presented the ASX as a hybrid. And: 40 years of Opel Corsa. We show its transformation from city car to urban e-vehicle.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: For decades, upper mid-range sedans have stood for the ideal combination of luxury, technology, and performance, especially for families and long distance travels. We put the hybrid Mercedes E 300 e and the fully electric VW ID.7 to the test.

programme.title: Vive la Evolution
programme.desc: For decades, French cars have combined extravagant design and innovation. The DS brand represents luxury and cutting-edge technology from Citroen. Does this also apply to the DS4? And: we tested the Peugeot 408 crossover SUV in Spain.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The Seat Ibiza turns 40 and we take a look back at the successes and highlights of this small car. And the big comparison: Mitsubishi ASX competes against its sister models Nissan Juke and Renault Captur. Which is better?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Cars from Asia are successful worldwide and there is an enormous variety. The Subaru BRZ with 234 hp and incredible handling offers adrenaline rushes at a low price. And: how good is the new Mitsubishi Colt compared to the competition?

programme.title: Has engine-tuner AMG reached the end of the road? What can be pimped in the electric AMG EQE 53?
programme.desc: Mercedes in-house tuner AMG has taken the electric E-Class EQE under its wing and unleashes the EQE 53 with 687 hp peak power. An impressive 1000 newtonmeters of maximum torque catapults the electric AMG to 100 km/h in just 3.3 seconds.

programme.title: Maserati Levante S
programme.desc: The Levante aims to be not just a Maserati SUV, but 'the Maserati of SUVs'.

programme.title: The Camaro 50th Anniversary Edition
programme.desc: 50 years of the Chevrolet Camaro. The American brand is celebrating with a special model with 453 hp. We tested the coupé in the foothills of the Alps.

programme.title: Ignition GT
programme.desc: The 2026 Toyota Matsuri featured new model unveilings, driving experiences and a celebration of the company’s heritage. The bZ4X stole the show at the inaugural event.

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
programme.desc: The team weighs up character versus practicality with the Mahindra Thar, compares higher-mileage double cabs on a budget, and helps choose the right car for a transport business.

programme.title: Sold in 60 seconds
programme.desc: Sabby discovers a Volkswagen Kombi that’s ideal for family road trips. An iconic Land Rover Series 1 goes under the hammer and we get into an apocalypse-proof Mercedes-Benz Unimog.

programme.title: Petrolheads
programme.desc: Kyle Clark explores Durban’s Concours D'Elegance, where fashion, food and hospitality meet rare vintage, classic and modern cars in a celebration of motoring excellence

programme.title: Porsche Techart Grand GT
programme.desc: The Techart Grand GT may look like Darth Vader's private ride, but it's in fact a souped-up version of the Porsche Panamera.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A trend is on the rise: going on mountain cruises in a sports car. As super cars become more comfortable and suitable for travelling in spite of their ever-increasing performance, what would be the perfect sports car for taking on the Alps: the Lamborghini Aventador Miura Homage, the Ferrari 458 Speciale, the McLaren 570S or the Porsche 911 Turbo S?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: To drive or be driven: That is the question for people who can afford such a choice. When it comes to the Bentley Mulsanne with its extended wheelbase, one could be more delighted to sit in the back of the car than in the front. But what is the situation when it comes to the sporty Maserati Quattroporte? Or the upgraded BMW 7 series by Alpina with the model name B7? Or the original, the BMW 750i?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Would you prefer a turbocharged or rather a naturally aspirated engine? With the 7th generation Chevrolet Corvette, buyers were able to choose between either. What's the more convincing model variation, the Grand Sport or Z06? Also: the McLaren 720, with its 4-litre BiTurbo V8. And: taking part in the "Bavaria Sportwagen Tour" with an AMG GTR.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you had the choice to select three cars for every occasion, which models would receive a spot in your garage? We took a look at the Rolls Royce Phantom, the Aston Martin DBS Superleggera and the Audi RS4 for this little mindgame.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2018, the Audi R8 Quattro Performance received an upgrade. The new version shared some of its aerodynamic features with the Lamborghini Huracan. Also: the Porsche Macan S got a more powerful engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The rebirth of French chic: the elegant DS 9 from Citroen's luxury brand. Plus: the Genesis GV80 offers luxury at a low price. And: a test drive in the exorbitantly expensive Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: High Forces [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

programme.title: Yesterday Once More [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Gu Yuxuan and Han Shuyan almost had a fated encounter when they were children. After they grew up, the two met again as they are destined to fall in love. After experiencing the happiness and sweetness of love, they had to face the test of fate together. Can the miracle of love keep them together?

programme.title: The 12th Suspect [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In this acclaimed whodunnit thriller, a bohemian teahouse becomes an interrogation room when the murder of a prominent poet brings a zealous detective to investigate--and he's marked every single customer as a potential suspect.

programme.title: EYE FOR AN EYE: THE BLIND SWORDSMAN [English Dub]
programme.desc: The story focuses on Visually impaired but nonetheless lethal bounty hunter Cheng Xiazi who happened upon the assaulted Ni Yan, the lone survivor of a brutal massacre that claimed her whole family.

programme.title: EYE FOR AN EYE 2: BLIND VENGEANCE [English Dub]
programme.desc: A blind swordsman reluctantly mentors an orphan seeking vengeance for his destroyed family, teaching him martial arts skills. The orphan waits for an opportunity to avenge his kin.

programme.title: Firefighters [English Dub]
programme.desc: Even in the harshest environments, firefighters must focus on extinguishing fires and rescuing everyone there. At 3:47 AM on March 4, 2001, the 119 emergency call center receives a phone call about a fire that has broken out in the Hongje-dong neighborhood. Firefighters, including newcomer Cheol-woong, rush to the scene.

programme.title: Oh Lucy! [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Bored Tokyo lady Setsuko (Independent Spirit Award-nominee Shinobu Terajima) breaks free of her monotonous life when her niece, Mika (Shioli Kutsuna) convinces her to enroll in an unorthodox English class. There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: Recalled [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Soo-jin, a woman suffering from post-traumatic memory loss, returns to her daily life with her loving husband. But her recovery takes an unexpected turn when she starts experiencing eerie visions: A child living being hit by a car, then a girl being harassed by a man. She runs into her former boss and learns that her husband may not be telling the truth about everything.

programme.title: Love, Again [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Hyun Woo is finally living freely after his divorce—whether by choice or not. When circumstances force him to confront his ex-wife, he’s determined to steer clear, afraid of slipping back into the misery of their married life. However, the news that she’s dating someone new unsettles him even more—especially when he discovers her boyfriend is his longtime high school rival.

programme.title: ESCAPE FROM MOGADISHU [English Dub]
programme.desc: Diplomats from the North and South Korean embassies in Somalia attempt a daring joint escape from Mogadishu when the outbreak of civil war leaves them stranded.

programme.title: The Big Swindle [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Five best swindlers in Korea form a team to rob Korea Bank, the biggest and most difficult bank to rob. Even as they work together for their common goal, each swindler has a secret agenda and does not trust others. After the bank is robbed, the police learn that the anonymous caller who helped them catch some members is a girlfriend of one of the swindlers and that she might be holding the key to solving the mysterious disappearance of money.

programme.title: PANDA PLAN [English Dub]
programme.desc: International action superstar Jackie Chan is involved in a rescue operation of a beloved zoo panda named Hu Hu.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: There is an iron rule in the Ching Hing Gang: No drug dealing. The gang leader, Yu Nam, has two right-hand men. One chooses to live in the bright world, while one is in the black. 15 yeas later, what will happen when they reunion?

programme.title: Glass Garden [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Jae-yeon's leg hasn't grown since she was twelve. She is a bioscientist researching on artificial blood based on a chloroplast. She believes that the chloroplast will help the recovery of one's physical body. At the conference, her assertion is considered as purely theoretical, while Soo-hee, her co-worker who stole her idea, gets good reviews. Moreover, Prof. Jung, Jae-yeon's lover, is having an affair with Soo-hee. That's why she isolated herself in the woods where she grew up. Meanwhile, Ji-hoon is an unknown novelist who has a hard time. His girlfriend broke up with him, and his career is in danger after his disrespectful behavior at a social gathering. He finds writing on the wall, saying, ''I was born from a tree.'' He asks around about the previous tenant and finds Jae-yeon in the woods. He starts observing her life and write what he sees as a novel.
